content.short: Decentralized, overcollateralized US dollar stablecoin with a savings rate and gasless transfers.
content.description: USDD holds its dollar peg through crypto collateral worth more than the supply, with governance handled by on-chain votes. There are about $1.5 billion USDD in circulation and more than $2 billion locked in the protocol. Holders can earn a savings rate, recently around 4%, on TRON, Ethereum and BNB Chain, and send USDD without holding TRX by paying the fee in USDD itself.
content.meta: USDD is an overcollateralized decentralized dollar with a savings rate and gasless transfers, with $1.5B in supply.
